signature: A lightless limestone cavern entered by a crouch-only crawl whose mouth shrinks behind you, its walls covered in reddish-brown drawings, and more painted pairs of eyes every time you look back.
notes: SOURCE: shallow crawl entrance, mouth smaller from within (no way back); large limestone cavern with earthy rocky walls, no natural light, height from ~2 m to much taller, stalactites, unknown length; reddish-brown drawings on all inspected walls (three stick figures round a campfire with two crossed out; above-threshold animals, some degraded; a stick figure enclosed by small irregular shapes), hand prints, clawing traces; one extinguished campfire and crude tools; few bugs (edibility unconfirmed); water only as drips from ceiling and stalactites; three incomplete remains three metres from the entrance (bloat, active decay, skeleton) with Dina A.'s 57-entry notebook (43 legible) in a torn rucksack with delivery papers; diary: feeling observed, more and more 'eyes', entries 52-56 drawn with eye pairs, last entry 'I se e yo u'; closing line about ignoring further supply requests. ADAPTATION: the remains lie on a short bare-rock apron in front of the mouth where the player arrives, because the page puts them three metres from the entrance in Plane #445 and does not describe Plane #445; the cave layout grammar (first hall, campfire alcove, 2 m low gallery, side loop, 13 m second hall with a ramp to a ledge, then a seeded endless gallery east) is ours; the crawl tapers to a hand-sized hole once the player stands in the cavern; the growing watch (about nine minutes to full, faster with the flashlight off) paints new eye pairs on walls outside the camera view (the dossier's plan; eye drawings are the diary's motif); stalactite lengths are clipped above head height in low sections. The playable world is a finite 5x5 window of 24 m chunks streamed around the player. Notebook text is a paraphrase with one short quote.
entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE. The watcher is only the courier's diary testimony; it is expressed as painted eye pairs that multiply, a heartbeat and subtitles, never a body.
no_exit_reason: The Level 52 page states no exit and says leaving through the entrance is impossible because the mouth is smaller from within. data/canon/transitions.json has no edge out of L052, so no exit is built; the crawl behind the player tapers to a hand-sized hole once they stand in the cavern.
